title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes (Main Guideline)
metaText: Comprehensive global standards for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of diabetes.

title: Management of Diabetes in Pregnancy (ADA Guideline)
metaText: The prevalence of diabetes in pregnancy has been increasing in the U.S. in parallel with the worldwide epidemic of obesity.

title: Diagnosis and Classification of Diabetes (ADA Guideline)
metaText: Diabetes mellitus is a group of metabolic disorders of carbohydrate metabolism in which glucose is both underutilized as an energy source and overproduced due to inappropriate gluconeogenesis and glycogenolysis, resulting in hyperglycemia

title: WHO Guideline for the pharmacological treatment of hypertension in adults
metaText: More people die each year from cardiovascular diseases than from any other cause. Over three quarters of heart disease and stroke-related deaths occur in low-income and middle-income countries.

title: National Guideline on Hypertension (NCDC & DGHS)
metaText: Hypertension or elevated blood pressure significantly increases the risk of disease of the heart, brain, kidney and other organs and it is the leading cause of death globally.

title: National Guideline on Diabetes Mellitus (NCDC & DGHS)
metaText: Diabetes is a major health issue that has reached a pandemic level. In Bangladesh, the treatment of diabetes is mainly provided by general physicians and specialist physicians, including endocrinologists and diabetologists, through government and private healthcare facilities.

title: National Guideline and Operational Manual for Tuberculosis (NCDC & DGHS)
metaText: Tuberculosis (TB) continues to be a global public health problem, particularly in the developing countries. Nearly one-third of the global population (i.e., two billion people) is infected with Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) and is at risk of developing the disease.

title: National Guideline on Clinical Management of Chikungunya Fever (NCDC & DGHS)
metaText: Chikungunya fever (CF) is a viral illness caused by an arbovirus transmitted by the Aedes mosquitoes. The disease was documented first time in the form of an outbreak in Tanzania.

title: National Guideline for Animal Bite Management in Bangladesh 2021
metaText: Rabies is a fatal viral disease. Globally, every year many people and livestock die of this disease and so is also Bangladesh is ranked third in the world list for rabies infection.

title: Revised Malaria Treatment Regimen-2017 (CDC, DGHS)
metaText: Based on the Revised Malaria Control strategy of early diagnosis and prompt treatment (EDPT) the then National Malaria Control Program, Bangladesh adopted the treatment regimen in 1994 through a consensus workshop..

title: National Guideline for Clinical Management of Dengue Syndrome
metaText: Dengue is a disease caused by an arbovirus, which has four serotypes and that is transmitted by Aedes mosquito.

title: National Guidelines For The Management Of Tuberculosis In Children
metaText: The 2020 WHO Global Tuberculosis Report estimates of 10 million people fell ill from TB and among them 56% were men, 32% were women and 12% were children

title: Type 2 diabetes in adults: management (NICE 2026)
metaText: This guideline covers care and management for adults (aged 18 and over) with type 2 diabetes.

title: Type 1 diabetes in adults: diagnosis and management (NICE 2026)
metaText: This guideline covers care and treatment for adults (aged 18 and over) with type 1 diabetes.

title: Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management (NICE 2026)
metaText: This guideline covers identifying and treating primary hypertension (high blood pressure) in people aged 18 and over, including people with type 2 diabetes.
